instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive controls and key information cards contain descriptive `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, modals, or floating AI panels.
Use Lucide-React icons for UI elements; avoid using AI emoji characters in UI buttons or badges.
Keep color cues purposeful: sky-blue for main actions, emerald-green for success states, amber for pending/rescheduled, red strictly for critical alerts or appointment cancellation.
For maps, render interactive Leaflet maps with custom popups, directions triggers, and marker pins.
Ensure complete responsive layout with role-based sidebar layout (Patient, Doctor, Admin).
Use Sonner for user toast feedback (booking confirmed, report uploaded, appointment rescheduled).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain clean medical clarity with generous whitespace, high-contrast readable typography, soft neutral borders, rounded corners (rounded-2xl for cards), zero visual clutter, and seamless accessibility across desktop and mobile screens.
